source: Shapes taken from Twilio's own published packages: the zod schemas in twilio-agent-connect 2.4.0 (dist/index.d.ts: SetupMessageSchema, PromptMessageSchema, InterruptMessageSchema, DtmfMessageSchema, TextTokenMessageSchema, PendingHandoffDataSchema), the message types in @twilio-forward/conversationrelay-bridge 0.2.0 (dist/session.d.ts: PlayMessage, ErrorMessage), and the ConversationRelay TwiML attributes in twilio 6.1.2 (lib/twiml/VoiceResponse.d.ts). The values are made up. Not yet checked against a live call (lesson L-016): replace this with a captured message from the first live call.
